_about: Every number shown in README.md, docs/*.md and docs/img/*. Hardware: 1x NVIDIA A100 80GB (sm_80), vLLM 0.31.0, greedy decoding (temperature 0), 96 fixed prompts (bench/prompts96.jsonl), max_tokens 1024. c=1 = mean per-request decode tok/s over the 96 prompts (2 repetitions); c=32 = aggregate output tok/s of the 96-prompt run at concurrency 32. null = gate not run for that configuration. Charts: python tools/make_charts.py.

progress._about: Milestones in development order. Each step was accepted on a same-session A/B against the previous best; the steps were measured in different sessions, so they are a history, not an additive decomposition. Values = tok/s for c=1 (mean, vs 196.5) and ratio vs best vLLM for c=32 (vs 1757.1; the earliest c=32 engine-only rows were measured against 1749-1751).

+ int4 shadow lm_head + 64k draft vocabulary (candidate selection only)
+ CUDA GDN tree-verify kernel

step_breakdown._about: torch-profiler step breakdowns (ms per decode step). c=1: one step = draft a 16-node tree + verify it; c=32: one step = MTP drafts for all running requests + one batched verify.

gates._about: Accuracy gates. GSM8K: greedy, thinking disabled, answer from \boxed{} (bench/acc_gsm8k.py). Long-context: 36 passkey / multi-key retrieval items, 2k-6.5k tokens (bench/acc_longctx.py). Pass rule: GSM8K within 1 point of the stock reference, long-context 36/36.
